question: Select the most appropriate title for the given passage.

options.text: A Few Good Policies and Less Farm Fires

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage discusses** the reduction in farm fires and the policies implemented to achieve this reduction.**
 
• It** highlights** the combined efforts of technology, government-backed incentives, and political responsibility in tackling the problem of stubble burning.
 
• The title **"A Few Good Policies and Less Farm Fires" **succinctly captures the essence of the passage.
 
• The other options do not adequately reflect the main focus of the passage.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2: A Few Good Policies and Less Farm Fires**.
